digest.component_or_area: tests/ test infrastructure and subprocess launching
propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations by re-deciding basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and env separately; consolidation into a single helper eliminates duplication and ensures consistent --basetemp usage.

Three sites currently lack --basetemp: test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py (executing real integration nodes), test_git_version_floor.py and test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py (--collect-only children), and this defect has manifested as three separate closed bugs.

The run_nested_pytest helper must forward env verbatim without merging onto os.environ or adding/removing keys, because four security-test sites intentionally pass minimal two- or three-key mappings that rely on bounded repr truncation semantics.

The helper must return CompletedProcess unmodified, pass timeout to subprocess.run as a keyword argument, and allow subprocess.TimeoutExpired to propagate; the call contract is pinned by test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py.

An AST guard scans tests/**/*.py for list-or-tuple literals containing sys.executable, -m, pytest in consecutive positions to enforce exactly one nested-pytest launch site (the helper definition); the guard deliberately ignores prose occurrences of -m pytest and supports escape marker # nested-pytest-ok.
The helper creates parent directories for tmp_path/nested-pytest before launching because pytest's --basetemp does not create missing parents, failing with FileNotFoundError if they do not exist.
